### What it does

Starts a web session: the server sets the `XSRF-TOKEN` and session cookies in the browser. Not under `/api/v1`.

### Screen

When the website loads, before **Log in**, and again after a 419.

### Who can call it

Anyone (web only).

### Request

- `GET {{appUrl}}/sanctum/csrf-cookie`, with cookies (`credentials: 'include'` / `withCredentials: true`).
- No body.

### Success

**204** with no body. The browser now has the `XSRF-TOKEN` cookie. Send it back as the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header on the next requests (axios does this by itself).

### Errors

- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### Notes

- Call it again when a request answers **419**.
- In Postman, the folder script copies the cookie into `X-XSRF-TOKEN` for you.

### What it does

Creates a new account. It does not log the user in.

### Screen

**Sign up** page, when the visitor clicks **Create account**.

### Who can call it

Guest (not logged in).

### Request

- `name` (string, required): up to 255 characters.
- `phone` (string, required): any Egyptian mobile format (`01000000000`, `+201000000000`, `00201000000000`, spaces, dashes and Arabic digits are fine). The server saves it as `+201XXXXXXXXX`.
- `password` (string, required): 8 to 64 characters.
- `password_confirmation` (string, required): the same password again.
- `register_as` (required): `business` (business owner) or `tayar`, from the choice on the first screen. Individual customers come later.
- `Accept-Language` is saved as the account language (used for SMS).

### Success

**201** with:
- `data`: the new user: `id`, `name`, `phone`, `email`, `account_type` (`individual` | `business`), `register_as` (`business` | `tayar`, or null for accounts from before sign up asked for it), `next_step` (the screen to open: see **Get my account**), `locale` (`ar` | `en`), `status` (`active` | `blocked`), `is_phone_verified`, `phone_verified_at`, `national_id` (`status`: null | `pending` | `approved` | `rejected`, `rejection_reason`, `verified_at`, `front` and `back` files with a signed `url`), `business_profile` (or null), `last_mode` (`client` | `tayar`: the mode the app reopens in), `tayar_profile` (`id`, `status`, `is_online`, `rejection_reason`, `can_reapply_at`, or null when the user never applied), `roles` (staff role names, for display only; an empty list for customers) and `permissions` (what the user may do; an empty list for customers, every permission for a super admin). `next_step` is `complete_business_profile` or `complete_tayar_application`: after the code screen and Login, open that form.
- `phone_verification_required` (boolean): when true, an SMS code was sent.
- `resend_available_in` (number of seconds, or null): how long until **Resend code** may send another code. Null when no code was sent.
- `message`: "Your account has been created."

**Next:** If `phone_verification_required` is true, open the OTP page with the countdown from `resend_available_in`; otherwise go to Login.

### Errors

- **422:** field errors. A phone that already has an account gets `errors.phone` = "This phone number already has an account. Please log in, or use forgot password.": show it with links to Login and Forgot password.
- **429:** too many attempts from this phone number or this IP address (users on the same network share the IP limit). Wait for `Retry-After` seconds, then let the user retry.
- **426 (mobile):** the app is too old. Show the force-update screen.
- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### Notes

- Register never changes an existing account. An unverified user who comes back finishes with **Resend code** and **Verify phone**, not with register again.
- Limits: 5 requests per phone number and 20 per IP address every 60 minutes (users on the same network share the IP limit). **Sign up**, **Resend code** and **Forgot password** share one limit per phone.

### What it does

Confirms the phone number with the SMS code. It does not log the user in.

### Screen

**OTP** page, when the visitor submits the code.

### Who can call it

Guest.

### Request

- `phone` (string, required): any Egyptian mobile format (`01000000000`, `+201000000000`, `00201000000000`, spaces, dashes and Arabic digits are fine). The server saves it as `+201XXXXXXXXX`.
- `code` (string, required): the 6-digit code from the SMS.

### Success

**200** with `message` ("Your phone number has been verified.").

**Next:** Show "Phone verified" and go to Login.

### Errors

- **422:** The same error for a wrong code, an expired code, a used code, a code with too many wrong tries (5 per code) and an unknown phone: `errors.code` = "The code is wrong or has expired…". Show it under the code input and offer **Resend code**.
- **429:** too many attempts from this phone number or this IP address (users on the same network share the IP limit). Wait for `Retry-After` seconds, then let the user retry.
- **426 (mobile):** the app is too old. Show the force-update screen.
- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### Notes

- A code is valid for 5 minutes and allows 5 wrong tries.
- Limits: 5 tries per phone number and 20 per IP address every 60 minutes (users on the same network share the IP limit). **Verify phone** and **Reset password** share one limit per phone.

### What it does

Sends a new SMS code for phone verification or for a password reset.

### Screen

**OTP** page (purpose `verify_phone`) and **Reset password** page (purpose `reset_password`), when the countdown is over and the visitor clicks **Resend code**.

### Who can call it

Guest.

### Request

- `phone` (string, required): any Egyptian mobile format (`01000000000`, `+201000000000`, `00201000000000`, spaces, dashes and Arabic digits are fine). The server saves it as `+201XXXXXXXXX`.
- `purpose` (required): `verify_phone` or `reset_password`.

### Success

**200** with `message` ("If this phone number can receive a code, we have sent one."). Restart the resend countdown at 60 seconds.

### Errors

- **422:** field errors.
- **429:** too many attempts from this phone number or this IP address (users on the same network share the IP limit). Wait for `Retry-After` seconds, then let the user retry.
- **426 (mobile):** the app is too old. Show the force-update screen.
- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### Notes

- **Same answer for registered and unknown phones**, and for an already verified phone: never tell the user whether the number has an account.
- Within 60 seconds of the last code, nothing new is sent and the earlier code stays valid. Keep the **Resend** button disabled during the countdown.
- A new code replaces the old one.
- Limits: 5 requests per phone number and 20 per IP address every 60 minutes (users on the same network share the IP limit). **Sign up**, **Resend code** and **Forgot password** share one limit per phone.

### What it does

Web login with a session cookie. No token is returned.

### Screen

**Login** page, when the visitor clicks **Log in** (after **Get CSRF cookie**).

### Who can call it

Guest, from the React website or admin panel.

### Request

- First call `GET {{appUrl}}/sanctum/csrf-cookie`.
- Send with cookies and the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header.
- `phone` (string, required): any Egyptian mobile format (`01000000000`, `+201000000000`, `00201000000000`, spaces, dashes and Arabic digits are fine). The server saves it as `+201XXXXXXXXX`.
- `password` (string, required): up to 64 characters.

### Success

**200** with `data`, the logged-in user: `id`, `name`, `phone`, `email`, `account_type` (`individual` | `business`), `register_as` (`business` | `tayar`, or null for accounts from before sign up asked for it), `next_step` (the screen to open: see **Get my account**), `locale` (`ar` | `en`), `status` (`active` | `blocked`), `is_phone_verified`, `phone_verified_at`, `national_id` (`status`: null | `pending` | `approved` | `rejected`, `rejection_reason`, `verified_at`, `front` and `back` files with a signed `url`), `business_profile` (or null), `last_mode` (`client` | `tayar`: the mode the app reopens in), `tayar_profile` (`id`, `status`, `is_online`, `rejection_reason`, `can_reapply_at`, or null when the user never applied), `roles` (staff role names, for display only; an empty list for customers) and `permissions` (what the user may do; an empty list for customers, every permission for a super admin). The session cookie is now set; later requests just send cookies.

**Next:** Call **Get my account**, then open the page for `next_step`.

### Errors

- **400:** the request did not come from a trusted website domain (`SANCTUM_STATEFUL_DOMAINS`), so no session could start.
- **419:** the CSRF cookie is missing or old: call `sanctum/csrf-cookie` again and retry.
- **422:** wrong phone or password: `errors.phone` = "These credentials do not match our records.".
- **403:** the account is blocked, or the phone is not verified while phone verification is on. Show `message`.
- **429:** too many login tries: 5 per minute for each phone number from the same IP address, or 20 per hour for one phone number from any IP address. Wait for `Retry-After` seconds, then let the user retry.
- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### Notes

- Limits: 5 tries per minute for each phone number from the same IP address, plus 20 per hour for each phone number from any IP address. Mobile and web login share these limits.

### What it does

Sends a password reset code by SMS.

### Screen

**Forgot password** page, when the visitor clicks **Send code**.

### Who can call it

Guest.

### Request

- `phone` (string, required): any Egyptian mobile format (`01000000000`, `+201000000000`, `00201000000000`, spaces, dashes and Arabic digits are fine). The server saves it as `+201XXXXXXXXX`.

### Success

**200** with `message` ("If an account exists for this phone number, we have sent it a reset code."). Always go to the Reset password screen.

**Next:** Open the Reset password page with the phone filled in.

### Errors

- **422:** the phone is missing or not a valid Egyptian mobile number.
- **429:** too many attempts from this phone number or this IP address (users on the same network share the IP limit). Wait for `Retry-After` seconds, then let the user retry.
- **426 (mobile):** the app is too old. Show the force-update screen.
- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### Notes

- **Same answer for registered and unknown phones**: never tell the user whether the number has an account.
- Always uses the SMS code, even when phone verification is off.
- Within 60 seconds of the last code, nothing new is sent and the earlier code stays valid.
- Limits: 5 requests per phone number and 20 per IP address every 60 minutes (users on the same network share the IP limit). **Sign up**, **Resend code** and **Forgot password** share one limit per phone.

### What it does

Sets a new password with the reset code from the SMS.

### Screen

**Reset password** page, when the visitor clicks **Save**.

### Who can call it

Guest.

### Request

- `phone` (string, required): any Egyptian mobile format (`01000000000`, `+201000000000`, `00201000000000`, spaces, dashes and Arabic digits are fine). The server saves it as `+201XXXXXXXXX`.
- `code` (string, required): the code from the reset SMS.
- `password` (string, required): 8 to 64 characters.
- `password_confirmation` (string, required): the same password again.

### Success

**200** with `message` ("Your password has been reset."). Go to Login. The user is signed out of every device, and the phone counts as verified.

**Next:** Show "Password changed" and go to Login.

### Errors

- **422:** The same error for a wrong code, an expired code, a used code, a code with too many wrong tries (5 per code) and an unknown phone: `errors.code` = "The code is wrong or has expired…". Show it under the code input and offer **Resend code**. Password errors come under `errors.password`.
- **429:** too many attempts from this phone number or this IP address (users on the same network share the IP limit). Wait for `Retry-After` seconds, then let the user retry.
- **426 (mobile):** the app is too old. Show the force-update screen.
- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### Notes

- Use the code from **Forgot password** (purpose `reset_password`); a sign-up code doesn't work here.
- Limits: 5 tries per phone number and 20 per IP address every 60 minutes (users on the same network share the IP limit). **Verify phone** and **Reset password** share one limit per phone.

### What it does

Returns the logged-in user with everything the account screens need.

### Screen

**Account menu** on every page load, and the **Account** page.

### Who can call it

Any logged-in user who is not blocked (customer, business or staff).

### Request

- No body. Send the Bearer token (mobile) or the session cookie (web).

### Success

**200** with `data`, the user: `id`, `name`, `phone`, `email`, `account_type` (`individual` | `business`), `register_as` (`business` | `tayar`, or null for accounts from before sign up asked for it), `next_step` (the screen to open: see **Get my account**), `locale` (`ar` | `en`), `status` (`active` | `blocked`), `is_phone_verified`, `phone_verified_at`, `national_id` (`status`: null | `pending` | `approved` | `rejected`, `rejection_reason`, `verified_at`, `front` and `back` files with a signed `url`), `business_profile` (or null), `last_mode` (`client` | `tayar`: the mode the app reopens in), `tayar_profile` (`id`, `status`, `is_online`, `rejection_reason`, `can_reapply_at`, or null when the user never applied), `roles` (staff role names, for display only; an empty list for customers) and `permissions` (what the user may do; an empty list for customers, every permission for a super admin).

`next_step` says which screen to open, also after a reinstall or a login on another phone:
- `complete_business_profile`: the business profile form → **Create business profile**.
- `business_under_review`: the "waiting for review" screen (**Get business profile**).
- `business_rejected`: show `business_profile.rejection_reason` and let the user fix the data or documents (**Update business profile**, **Upload document**).
- `complete_tayar_application`: the tayar application form → **Get vehicle types**, then **Apply to be a tayar**.

item.name: 4. Business onboarding

Business accounts (`account_type` = `business`; new sign ups have `register_as` = `business`):

1. After login, if **Get my account** has `business_profile: null`, open the **Onboarding wizard**.
2. Wizard step 1, **Business details**: business type (from **Get business types**), name, description, average daily orders, tax registration number, and links.

### What it does

Lists the active main categories, each with its active subcategories, for the category picker of a new order.

### Screen

**New order › Category** step, on open.

Anyone, no login.

item.name: 7. Orders
item.description:
Sending and following orders, for **approved business accounts** (`next_step` = `ready`; individual customers come later). Other accounts get **403** with a message: show it with a link to the business profile.

1. **New order** page: category (**Get categories**, folder 6) → pickup and drop-off on the map → **Estimate price** (call it again whenever the category or a point changes) → receiver, goods value, who pays the shipping, details → **Create order** with the `shipping_fee` the user saw.
2. Make one `idempotency_key` (UUID) when the New order page opens and keep it for every retry of **Create order**. A 200 means the order already existed: open it as if it were new.
3. A 422 on `shipping_fee` means the price changed: show the new price from the message, ask again, and send the new `shipping_fee` with the same key.
4. **My orders** page: two tabs, Active and Past → **Get my orders** with `status` = `active` or `past`. Load more with `cursor` = `meta.next_cursor`.
5. **Order details** → **Get order**. Show **Cancel order** while `can_cancel` is true.
6. **Cancel** dialog → **Get cancel reasons**, then **Cancel order** with the picked reason and an optional note.
7. While `status` = `looking_for_tayar`, **Order details** shows "Looking for a tayar…" until `search_ends_at`, and calls **Get order** again every 10 seconds while the page is open.
8. When a tayar accepts (`status` = `pending`), show the `tayar` card: name, phone and the vehicle (`type`, `model`, `color`, `plate_number`). **Cancel order** stays until pickup: free until `free_cancel_until` (120 seconds), then the **Cancel** dialog shows the fee from `cancel_fee_now`, owed to the tayar.
9. `cancelled_by_type` = `system`: no tayar accepted in time. Show "No tayar found" with a **Send again** button that opens New order with the same details and a new `idempotency_key`.
10. From acceptance to delivery, **Order details** shows the tayar on a map from `tayar.location` (with how old `updated_at` is) and the steps: picked up (with the pickup photos), on the way, delivered or not delivered (with the reason). Reload every 10 to 15 seconds while the page is open. There is no ETA.
11. After pickup nobody can cancel. The receiver gets the codes and the tracking link by SMS (only once a real SMS provider is configured); a **Copy tracking link** button can build it from `tracking_token` (folder 8). Delivery does not check payment yet.

request.description:
### What it does

Prices a trip before the order is created. Nothing is saved.

### Screen

**New order › Price** step, after both points are on the map, and again when the category or a point changes.

### Who can call it

An approved business account (individual customers come later).

### Request

- `category_id` (number, required): a subcategory from **Get categories** (one of a main category's `children`).
- `pickup_lat`, `pickup_lng`, `dropoff_lat`, `dropoff_lng` (numbers, required): the points picked on the map, up to 7 decimals.

### Success

**200** with `data`: `{ distance_km, food_extra, shipping_fee }`, strings with two decimals (km and EGP). Show `shipping_fee` as the price, and keep it to send with **Create order**.

### Errors

- **422:** field errors.
- **422:** `errors.route`: the pickup and drop-off are less than 100 m apart (in a straight line), the drop-off is more than 1200 km (by road) from the pickup, Tayari does not deliver on this route yet, or a food order is too far (food only goes up to 15 km, or inside one area). Show it on the map step.
- **401:** not logged in, or the login expired. Clear the stored login and go to Login.
- **403:** `message` explains why: only business accounts can send orders for now, or the business profile is not approved yet. Show the message with a link to the business profile page.
- **426 (mobile):** the app is too old. Show the force-update screen.
- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### Notes

- The price is the larger of the minimum fare and the base fare + price per km × distance, plus a food extra for food categories. The distance is the straight line times a road factor, so it is a little longer than on the map.
- The customer never picks a mode: Tayari picks it from the trip.
- Call it again whenever the category or a point changes.

### What it does

Creates an order at the price from **Estimate price**. The order starts in `looking_for_tayar`.

### Screen

**New order › Confirm** step, when the user clicks **Send order**.

### Who can call it

An approved business account (individual customers come later).

### Request

- `idempotency_key` (string, required): a UUID made once when the order form opens, and sent again on every retry of the same order.
- `category_id` (number, required): a subcategory from **Get categories** (one of a main category's `children`).
- `pickup_lat`, `pickup_lng`, `dropoff_lat`, `dropoff_lng` (numbers, required): the points picked on the map, up to 7 decimals.
- `details` (string, optional, up to 2000 characters): what is in the package.
- `pickup_address`, `dropoff_address` (strings, required, up to 255 characters).
- `pickup_contact_phone` (string, optional): someone to call at the pickup, if not the sender; any Egyptian mobile format.
- `receiver_name` (string, required, up to 255 characters) and `receiver_phone` (string, required, any Egyptian mobile format).
- `goods_value` (required): the price of the goods the receiver pays, 0 to 1000000, up to 2 decimals.
- `shipping_paid_by` (required): `sender` or `receiver`.
- `shipping_fee` (required): the `shipping_fee` from **Estimate price**, as shown to the user.

### Success

**201** with `data`, the new order: `id`, `code` (the short code people see, e.g. `TY-7K3P9Q`), `status` (`looking_for_tayar` | `pending` | `picked_up` | `ongoing` | `delivered` | `not_delivered` | `cancelled`), `can_cancel` (true until pickup), `category` (`id`, `name`, `is_food`), `details`, `pickup` (`address`, `lat`, `lng`, `contact_phone`), `dropoff` (`address`, `lat`, `lng`), `receiver` (`name`, `phone`), `goods_value`, `shipping_paid_by` (`sender` | `receiver`), `amount_to_collect` (what the receiver pays: the goods value, plus the shipping fee when the receiver pays it), `distance_km`, `food_extra`, `shipping_fee`, `cancel_reason` (`id`, `name`, or null), `tayar` (null until a tayar accepts; then `name`, `phone` (null once the order is delivered, not delivered or cancelled) and `vehicle` (`type`, `model`, `color`, `plate_number`)), `cancelled_by_type` (null unless cancelled; then `sender`, `staff`, or `system` when no tayar accepted in time), `free_cancel_until` (while `pending`: until when cancelling is free; otherwise null), `cancel_fee_now` (what cancelling now would cost: `"0.00"` before a tayar accepts and until `free_cancel_until`, then the cancellation fee, at most the shipping fee), `cancel_fee` (the fee recorded when the order was cancelled, `"0.00"` otherwise), `search_ends_at` (while `looking_for_tayar`: when Tayari stops looking and cancels the order; otherwise null), `price_accepted_at`, `accepted_at` (when the tayar accepted, or null), `cancelled_at`, `created_at`, `updated_at`. Amounts are strings with two decimals, in EGP; coordinates are strings with 7 decimals. Delivery: `tayar.location` (`lat`, `lng`, `updated_at`: the tayar's last position while the order is `pending`, `picked_up` or `ongoing`, otherwise null), `pickup_photos` (the tayar's photos at pickup, each with a signed `url`), `picked_up_at`, `receiver_confirmed_at`, `codes_sent_at` (when the receiver's codes were last sent by SMS), `delivered_at`, `not_delivered_at`, `not_delivered_reason` (`id`, `name`, or null), `not_delivered_note`, `tracking_token` (for the receiver's tracking link). **200** with the same order when this `idempotency_key` already made one (a double tap or a retry).

**Next:** Open **Order details** for the returned order (201 or 200).

### Errors

- **422:** field errors. When the price changed since the estimate: `errors.shipping_fee` = "The shipping price is now 45.00 EGP. Check the new price and confirm again." Show the new price and ask the user to confirm again (send the new `shipping_fee` with the same `idempotency_key`). When the order this `idempotency_key` made was deleted: `errors.idempotency_key` = "This request key belongs to a deleted order. Use a new request key." Make a new key and send again.
- **422:** `errors.route`: the pickup and drop-off are less than 100 m apart (in a straight line), the drop-off is more than 1200 km (by road) from the pickup, Tayari does not deliver on this route yet, or a food order is too far (food only goes up to 15 km, or inside one area). Show it on the map step.
- **401:** not logged in, or the login expired. Clear the stored login and go to Login.
- **403:** `message` explains why: only business accounts can send orders for now, or the business profile is not approved yet. Show the message with a link to the business profile page.
- **426 (mobile):** the app is too old. Show the force-update screen.
- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### Notes

- Disable the **Send** button while the request runs, but keep the same `idempotency_key` for retries: the server never creates two orders for one key. Make a new key only for a new order.
- Phones come back as `+201XXXXXXXXX`.
- The search for a tayar starts at once: the order is offered to up to 5 nearby tayars at a time, each offer lasting 60 seconds, in a wider circle each round around the pickup (3 km, then 3 km more each round, up to 10 km; a round with nobody in reach widens at once). When no tayar accepts by `search_ends_at` (15 minutes after the price was accepted), Tayari cancels the order (`cancelled_by_type` = `system`) and sends an `order_no_tayar` push.

Lists my orders, newest first: the Active tab or the Past tab.

The receiver's public tracking page at `/track/{token}` (the link in the receiver's SMS; set the same URL in `TRACKING_URL` on the server). No login.

item.name: React admin panel
item.description:
The admin panel for Tayari staff.

item.name: 1. Login
item.description:
1. On panel load, call **Get CSRF cookie**.
2. **Admin login** page: phone and password → **Log in**.
3. Call **Get my account**. A user with an empty `permissions` list can't use the panel: show "not allowed" and log them out.
4. Build the side menu and buttons from `permissions` only (for example, show **Business profiles** only with `business_profiles.view`, and the Approve and Reject buttons only with `business_profiles.review`). A super admin gets every permission. Show `roles` only as a label.

request.description:
### What it does

Starts a web session: the server sets the `XSRF-TOKEN` and session cookies in the browser. Not under `/api/v1`.

### Screen

When the admin panel loads, before **Log in**, and again after a 419.

### Who can call it

Anyone (web only).

### Request

- `GET {{appUrl}}/sanctum/csrf-cookie`, with cookies (`credentials: 'include'` / `withCredentials: true`).
- No body.

### Success

**204** with no body. The browser now has the `XSRF-TOKEN` cookie. Send it back as the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header on the next requests (axios does this by itself).

### Errors

- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### Notes

- Call it again when a request answers **419**.
- In Postman, the folder script copies the cookie into `X-XSRF-TOKEN` for you.

### What it does

Web login with a session cookie. No token is returned.

### Screen

**Admin login** page, when the staff member clicks **Log in**.

### Who can call it

Guest, from the React website or admin panel.

### Request

- First call `GET {{appUrl}}/sanctum/csrf-cookie`.
- Send with cookies and the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header.
- `phone` (string, required): any Egyptian mobile format (`01000000000`, `+201000000000`, `00201000000000`, spaces, dashes and Arabic digits are fine). The server saves it as `+201XXXXXXXXX`.
- `password` (string, required): up to 64 characters.

### Success

**200** with `data`, the logged-in user: `id`, `name`, `phone`, `email`, `account_type` (`individual` | `business`), `register_as` (`business` | `tayar`, or null for accounts from before sign up asked for it), `next_step` (the screen to open: see **Get my account**), `locale` (`ar` | `en`), `status` (`active` | `blocked`), `is_phone_verified`, `phone_verified_at`, `national_id` (`status`: null | `pending` | `approved` | `rejected`, `rejection_reason`, `verified_at`, `front` and `back` files with a signed `url`), `business_profile` (or null), `last_mode` (`client` | `tayar`: the mode the app reopens in), `tayar_profile` (`id`, `status`, `is_online`, `rejection_reason`, `can_reapply_at`, or null when the user never applied), `roles` (staff role names, for display only; an empty list for customers) and `permissions` (what the user may do; an empty list for customers, every permission for a super admin). The session cookie is now set; later requests just send cookies.

**Next:** Call **Get my account** and build the menu from `permissions`.

### Errors

- **400:** the request did not come from a trusted website domain (`SANCTUM_STATEFUL_DOMAINS`), so no session could start.
- **419:** the CSRF cookie is missing or old: call `sanctum/csrf-cookie` again and retry.
- **422:** wrong phone or password: `errors.phone` = "These credentials do not match our records.".
- **403:** the account is blocked, or the phone is not verified while phone verification is on. Show `message`.
- **429:** too many login tries: 5 per minute for each phone number from the same IP address, or 20 per hour for one phone number from any IP address. Wait for `Retry-After` seconds, then let the user retry.
- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### Notes

- Limits: 5 tries per minute for each phone number from the same IP address, plus 20 per hour for each phone number from any IP address. Mobile and web login share these limits.

item.name: 2. Business profiles review
item.description:
Needs `business_profiles.view` to see, `business_profiles.review` to decide:

1. **Review queue** page with tabs **Pending**, **Approved**, **Rejected** → **List business profiles** with `status`, paged.
2. Clicking a row opens the **Review details** page → **Get business profile**: business data, links, the owner (`user`), who reviewed it (`reviewed_by`), and the documents opened from their signed `url` in an image or PDF viewer.
3. **Approve** → **Approve business profile**.
4. **Reject** opens a dialog with a required reason → **Reject business profile**.
5. After either, go back to the queue; the profile leaves the Pending tab.

**Review details** page, when the staff member clicks **Approve** (confirm first).

item.name: 3. National IDs review
item.description:
Needs `national_ids.view` to see, `national_ids.review` to decide:

1. **Pending national IDs** page → **List pending national IDs**, paged.
2. Clicking a row opens **Review details** with the item from the list: the client's name and phone, and the front and back images from their signed `url`.
3. **Verify** → **Verify national ID**.
4. **Reject** opens a dialog with a required reason → **Reject national ID**.
5. After either, the ID leaves the list.

request.description:
### What it does

Lists client national IDs waiting for review (uploaded and not reviewed yet), oldest account first.

### Screen

**Pending national IDs** page, on open and on page change.

### Who can call it

Staff with `national_ids.view` (support, ops, admin, super admin).

### Request

- Query `per_page` (optional, 1 to 100, default 20) and `page`.

### Success

**200** with `data`: a list of `{ user: { id, name, phone, account_type }, status, rejection_reason, verified_at, reviewed_at, submitted_at, front, back }`, where `front` and `back` are files with a signed `url`. Plus `meta` and `links`.

### Errors

- **422:** `per_page` out of range.
- **401:** not logged in, or the login expired. Clear the stored login and go to Login.
- **403:** not a staff account, blocked, or missing the permission (`message` says which). Hide this action for users without the permission.
- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### Notes

- There is no separate "one ID" endpoint: open the details page with the item from this list. The image `url`s expire after 5 minutes.

### What it does

Marks a client's pending national ID as verified.

### Screen

**Review details** page, when the staff member clicks **Verify** (confirm first).

### Who can call it

Staff with `national_ids.review` (ops, admin, super admin).

### Request

- Path `user`: the user `id` (from `user.id` in the list). No body.

### Success

**200** with the review item (`status` = `approved`, `verified_at` set). Remove it from the list.

### Errors

- **404:** no user with this id.
- **422:** the ID is not waiting for review (`errors.status`): reload the list.
- **401:** not logged in, or the login expired. Clear the stored login and go to Login.
- **403:** not a staff account, blocked, or missing the permission (`message` says which). Hide this action for users without the permission. Staff (except super admins) can't review their own ID.
- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### Notes

- Hide the buttons for staff without `national_ids.review`.

### What it does

Rejects a client's pending national ID with a reason the client will see.

### Screen

**Review details** page, when the staff member confirms the **Reject** dialog with a reason.

### Who can call it

Staff with `national_ids.review` (ops, admin, super admin).

### Request

- Path `user`: the user `id`.
- `reason` (string, required): up to 255 characters, written for the client.

### Success

**200** with the review item (`status` = `rejected`, `rejection_reason`). Close the dialog and remove it from the list.

### Errors

- **404:** no user with this id.
- **422:** `errors.reason` (missing or too long) or `errors.status` (not waiting for review: reload the list).
- **401:** not logged in, or the login expired. Clear the stored login and go to Login.
- **403:** not a staff account, blocked, or missing the permission (`message` says which). Hide this action for users without the permission. Staff (except super admins) can't review their own ID.
- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### Notes

- The client can upload a new ID; it then shows up in the list again.

item.name: 4. Users
item.description:
Customer and business accounts. Needs `users.view` to see, `users.block` to block and unblock:

1. **Users** page: a search box (name or phone) and filters for account type, status, phone verified, national ID status and business profile status → **List users**, paged, newest first.
2. Clicking a row opens the **User details** page → **Get user**: account data, the national ID images and the business profile with its links and documents.
3. **Block** opens a dialog with a required reason → **Block user**. **Unblock** (on a blocked user) → **Unblock user**.
4. Staff accounts never show here: manage them under **Staff**.

request.description:
### What it does

Lists customer and business accounts (never staff), newest first, with search and filters.

### Screen

**Users** page, on open, on search, on filter change and on page change.

### Who can call it

Staff with `users.view` (support, ops, admin, super admin).

### Request

- Query `search` (optional, up to 100 characters), Arabic digits are fine:
  - a full Egyptian mobile number in any format (`01000000000`, `+201000000000`) finds that exact phone;
  - 4 or more digits find phones that contain them (a leading 0 is ignored, so `0100000` finds `+20100000…`);
  - anything else searches the name.
- Query `account_type` (optional): `individual` or `business`.
- Query `status` (optional): `active` or `blocked`.
- Query `phone_verified` (optional): `true` or `false`.
- Query `national_id_status` (optional): `none` (never uploaded), `pending`, `approved` or `rejected`.
- Query `business_profile_status` (optional): `pending`, `approved` or `rejected` (only business accounts with a profile).
- Query `per_page` (optional, 1 to 100, default 20) and `page`.

### Success

**200** with `data`: a list of users, each with `id`, `name`, `phone`, `email`, `account_type` (`individual` | `business`), `locale`, `status` (`active` | `blocked`), `blocked_reason`, `is_phone_verified`, `phone_verified_at`, `national_id` (`status`: null | `pending` | `approved` | `rejected`, `rejection_reason`, `verified_at`, `reviewed_at`, `front` and `back` files with a signed `url`), `business_profile` (or null), `created_at`. In the list, `business_profile` has the profile data without `business_type`, `links` and `documents`; open the user for those. Plus `meta` and `links` for pages.

### Errors

- **422:** an unknown filter value or `per_page` out of range.
- **401:** not logged in, or the login expired. Clear the stored login and go to Login.
- **403:** not a staff account, blocked, or missing the permission (`message` says which). Hide this action for users without the permission.
- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### Notes

- Keep the search and filters in the page URL, so the list survives a reload.

### What it does

Returns one customer or business account for the User details page: the national ID and the business profile with links and documents.

### Screen

**User details** page, on open.

### Who can call it

Staff with `users.view`.

### Request

- Path `customer`: the user `id` (from the list). No body.

### Success

**200** with `data`: `id`, `name`, `phone`, `email`, `account_type` (`individual` | `business`), `locale`, `status` (`active` | `blocked`), `blocked_reason`, `is_phone_verified`, `phone_verified_at`, `national_id` (`status`: null | `pending` | `approved` | `rejected`, `rejection_reason`, `verified_at`, `reviewed_at`, `front` and `back` files with a signed `url`), `business_profile` (or null), `created_at`, with `business_profile` in full: `id`, `business_type` (`id`, `name`), `business_name`, `description`, `avg_daily_orders`, `tax_registration_number`, `verification_status` (`pending` | `approved` | `rejected`), `rejection_reason`, `reviewed_at`, `links` (`id`, `type`, `url`), `documents` (`national_id_front`, `national_id_back`, `commercial_register` (the commercial register, السجل التجاري), `tax_card` (the tax card, البطاقة الضريبية): each a file with `file_name`, `mime_type`, `size`, `uploaded_at` and a signed `url`, or null), `created_at`, `updated_at`.

### Errors

- **404:** no customer with this id (staff accounts are 404 here too: manage them under **Staff**).
- **401:** not logged in, or the login expired. Clear the stored login and go to Login.
- **403:** not a staff account, blocked, or missing the permission (`message` says which). Hide this action for users without the permission.
- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### Notes

- A file comes without `url` when the staff member can't view that kind of document (`national_ids.view` for the national ID, `business_profiles.view` for business documents).
- The `url`s expire after 5 minutes: call it again to refresh them.

### What it does

Blocks a customer or business account with a reason. Their mobile logins are signed out at once, and every request from them answers 403.

### Screen

**User details** page, when the staff member confirms the **Block** dialog with a reason.

### Who can call it

Staff with `users.block` (ops, admin, super admin).

### Request

- Path `customer`: the user `id`.
- `reason` (string, required): up to 255 characters, for the staff (the user only sees "Your account has been blocked").

### Success

**200** with `data`, the user (`status` = `blocked`, `blocked_reason`): `id`, `name`, `phone`, `email`, `account_type` (`individual` | `business`), `locale`, `status` (`active` | `blocked`), `blocked_reason`, `is_phone_verified`, `phone_verified_at`, `national_id` (`status`: null | `pending` | `approved` | `rejected`, `rejection_reason`, `verified_at`, `reviewed_at`, `front` and `back` files with a signed `url`), `business_profile` (or null), `created_at`.

**Next:** Show the blocked banner with the reason and the **Unblock** button.

### Errors

- **404:** no customer with this id (staff accounts are 404 here too: manage them under **Staff**).
- **422:** `errors.reason` (missing or too long).
- **401:** not logged in, or the login expired. Clear the stored login and go to Login.
- **403:** not a staff account, blocked, or missing the permission (`message` says which). Hide this action for users without the permission.
- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### Notes

- Blocking a blocked user answers 200 and only replaces the reason.

### What it does

Unblocks a customer or business account and clears the reason.

### Screen

**User details** page, when the staff member clicks **Unblock** (confirm first).

### Who can call it

Staff with `users.block` (ops, admin, super admin).

### Request

- Path `customer`: the user `id`. No body.

### Success

**200** with `data`, the user (`status` = `active`, `blocked_reason` = null): `id`, `name`, `phone`, `email`, `account_type` (`individual` | `business`), `locale`, `status` (`active` | `blocked`), `blocked_reason`, `is_phone_verified`, `phone_verified_at`, `national_id` (`status`: null | `pending` | `approved` | `rejected`, `rejection_reason`, `verified_at`, `reviewed_at`, `front` and `back` files with a signed `url`), `business_profile` (or null), `created_at`.

### Errors

- **404:** no customer with this id (staff accounts are 404 here too: manage them under **Staff**).
- **401:** not logged in, or the login expired. Clear the stored login and go to Login.
- **403:** not a staff account, blocked, or missing the permission (`message` says which). Hide this action for users without the permission.
- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### Notes

- Unblocking an active user also answers 200. The user logs in again; old mobile tokens stay deleted.

item.name: 5. Business types
item.description:
The business types customers pick from. Needs `business_types.view` to see, `business_types.manage` to change:

1. **Business types** page with tabs **Active** and **Inactive** → **List business types** with `is_active`, an optional `search`, paged, in sort order.
2. **Add** opens the form page or dialog (Arabic name, English name, active, sort order) → **Create business type**.
3. **Edit** loads the type → **Get business type**, then **Save** → **Update business type**.
4. **Activate** / **Deactivate** on a row → **Activate business type** / **Deactivate business type**; the row moves to the other tab.
5. **Delete** opens a confirmation dialog → **Delete business type**. A type used by business profiles can't be deleted: the dialog shows the "deactivate it instead" message with a **Deactivate** button. Offer **Delete** only when `business_profiles_count` is 0.

request.description:
### What it does

Lists every business type, active and inactive, in sort order.

### Screen

**Business types** page, on open, on tab change (`is_active`), on search and on page change.

### Who can call it

Staff with `business_types.view` (support, ops, admin, super admin).

### Request

- Query `is_active` (optional): `true` for the Active tab, `false` for the Inactive tab; leave it out for all.
- Query `search` (optional, up to 100 characters): part of the Arabic or English name, any letter case.
- Query `per_page` (optional, 1 to 100, default 20) and `page`.

### Success

**200** with `data`: a list of business types, each with `id`, `name` (`ar` and `en`), `is_active`, `sort_order`, `business_profiles_count` (how many business profiles use it), `created_at`, `updated_at`. Plus `meta` and `links` for pages.

### Errors

- **422:** an invalid `is_active`, `search` too long or `per_page` out of range.
- **401:** not logged in, or the login expired. Clear the stored login and go to Login.
- **403:** not a staff account, blocked, or missing the permission (`message` says which). Hide this action for users without the permission.
- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### Notes

- Show **Delete** only when `business_profiles_count` is 0; otherwise offer **Deactivate**.

### What it does

Returns one business type with its name in both languages, to fill the edit form.

### Screen

**Edit business type** form, on open.

### Who can call it

Staff with `business_types.view`.

### Request

- Path `businessType`: the type `id`. No body.

### Success

**200** with `data`: `id`, `name` (`ar` and `en`), `is_active`, `sort_order`, `business_profiles_count` (how many business profiles use it), `created_at`, `updated_at`.

### Errors

- **404:** no business type with this id.
- **401:** not logged in, or the login expired. Clear the stored login and go to Login.
- **403:** not a staff account, blocked, or missing the permission (`message` says which). Hide this action for users without the permission.
- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### What it does

Creates a business type.

### Screen

**Add business type** form, when the staff member clicks **Save**.

### Who can call it

Staff with `business_types.manage` (admin, super admin).

### Request

- `name.ar` and `name.en` (strings, both required): up to 100 characters each, as `{ "name": { "ar": "مطعم", "en": "Restaurant" } }`.
- `is_active` (boolean, optional): default `true`.
- `sort_order` (number, optional): 0 to 65535. Left out, the type goes to the end of the list.

### Success

**201** with `data`, the new type: `id`, `name` (`ar` and `en`), `is_active`, `sort_order`, `business_profiles_count` (how many business profiles use it), `created_at`, `updated_at`.

**Next:** Close the form and reload the list.

### Errors

- **422:** field errors. A name another type already uses (ignoring letter case) gets `errors["name.ar"]` or `errors["name.en"]` = "Another business type already has this name."
- **401:** not logged in, or the login expired. Clear the stored login and go to Login.
- **403:** not a staff account, blocked, or missing the permission (`message` says which). Hide this action for users without the permission.
- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### Notes

- An active type shows up in the public **Get business types** list at once.

### What it does

Updates a business type. Send only the fields that change.

### Screen

**Edit business type** form, when the staff member clicks **Save**.

### Who can call it

Staff with `business_types.manage` (admin, super admin).

### Request

- Path `businessType`: the type `id`.
- Any of `name` (both `ar` and `en` when sent), `is_active`, `sort_order` (same rules as create).

### Success

**200** with `data`, the updated type: `id`, `name` (`ar` and `en`), `is_active`, `sort_order`, `business_profiles_count` (how many business profiles use it), `created_at`, `updated_at`.

**Next:** Close the form and update the row.

### Errors

- **404:** no business type with this id.
- **422:** field errors, for example a name with one language only, or a name another type already uses (ignoring letter case).
- **401:** not logged in, or the login expired. Clear the stored login and go to Login.
- **403:** not a staff account, blocked, or missing the permission (`message` says which). Hide this action for users without the permission.
- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### Notes

- Renaming a type changes the name every business profile with this type shows.

### What it does

Activates a business type, so it shows in the public list again.

### Screen

**Business types** page (Inactive tab), when the staff member clicks **Activate** on a row.

### Who can call it

Staff with `business_types.manage` (admin, super admin).

### Request

- Path `businessType`: the type `id`. No body.

### Success

**200** with `data`, the type (`is_active` = true): `id`, `name` (`ar` and `en`), `is_active`, `sort_order`, `business_profiles_count` (how many business profiles use it), `created_at`, `updated_at`. Move it to the Active tab.

### Errors

- **404:** no business type with this id.
- **401:** not logged in, or the login expired. Clear the stored login and go to Login.
- **403:** not a staff account, blocked, or missing the permission (`message` says which). Hide this action for users without the permission.
- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### Notes

- Activating an active type also answers 200.

### What it does

Deactivates a business type: it leaves the public list, and new business profiles can't pick it.

### Screen

**Business types** page (Active tab), when the staff member clicks **Deactivate** on a row, or **Deactivate** in the delete dialog.

### Who can call it

Staff with `business_types.manage` (admin, super admin).

### Request

- Path `businessType`: the type `id`. No body.

### Success

**200** with `data`, the type (`is_active` = false): `id`, `name` (`ar` and `en`), `is_active`, `sort_order`, `business_profiles_count` (how many business profiles use it), `created_at`, `updated_at`. Move it to the Inactive tab.

### Errors

- **404:** no business type with this id.
- **401:** not logged in, or the login expired. Clear the stored login and go to Login.
- **403:** not a staff account, blocked, or missing the permission (`message` says which). Hide this action for users without the permission.
- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### Notes

- Existing business profiles keep the type. Use this instead of delete for a type that is in use.

### What it does

Deletes a business type that no business profile uses.

### Screen

**Business types** page, when the staff member confirms the **Delete** dialog.

### Who can call it

Staff with `business_types.manage` (admin, super admin).

### Request

- Path `businessType`: the type `id`. No body.

### Success

**204** with no body. Remove the row.

**Next:** Remove the row. On 422, keep the dialog open with the message and a **Deactivate** button.

### Errors

- **404:** no business type with this id.
- **422:** a business profile uses the type: `errors.business_type` = "This business type is used by business profiles, so it cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead." Show it in the dialog with a **Deactivate** button.
- **401:** not logged in, or the login expired. Clear the stored login and go to Login.
- **403:** not a staff account, blocked, or missing the permission (`message` says which). Hide this action for users without the permission.
- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### Notes

- Ask for confirmation first; a delete can't be undone.

item.name: 6. Staff
item.description:
Admin panel accounts. Super admins only (`staff.manage`): hide this menu item for everyone else.

1. **Staff** page → **List staff**, paged, with each member's role and status.
2. **Add staff** form (name, phone, password, password again, role `admin`, `ops` or `support`) → **Create staff member**.
3. **Change role** on a row opens a role picker → **Change staff role**.
4. **Block** opens a dialog with a required reason → **Block staff member**. **Unblock** → **Unblock staff member**.
5. Hide **Change role** and **Block** on the logged-in user's own row. The last active super admin can't be blocked or demoted.

request.description:
### What it does

Lists staff members with their role and status, newest first.

### Screen

**Staff** page, on open and on page change.

### Who can call it

Staff with `staff.manage` (super admin only).

### Request

- Query `per_page` (optional, 1 to 100, default 20) and `page`.

### Success

**200** with `data`: a list of staff members, each with `id`, `name`, `phone`, `role` (`super_admin` | `admin` | `ops` | `support`), `status` (`active` | `blocked`), `blocked_reason`, `created_at`. Plus `meta` and `links` for pages.

### Errors

- **422:** `per_page` out of range.
- **401:** not logged in, or the login expired. Clear the stored login and go to Login.
- **403:** not a staff account, blocked, or missing the permission (`message` says which). Hide this action for users without the permission.
- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### Notes

- Hide the **Staff** menu item for users without `staff.manage`.

### What it does

Creates a staff account with a role. The staff member can log in to the admin panel at once with this phone and password.

### Screen

**Add staff** form, when the super admin clicks **Save**.

### Who can call it

Staff with `staff.manage` (super admin only).

### Request

- `name` (string, required): up to 255 characters.
- `phone` (string, required): any Egyptian mobile format (`01000000000`, `+201000000000`, `00201000000000`, spaces, dashes and Arabic digits are fine). The server saves it as `+201XXXXXXXXX`. It must not belong to any account, customer or staff.
- `password` (string, required): 8 to 64 characters.
- `password_confirmation` (string, required): the same password again.
- `role` (required): `admin`, `ops` or `support`. `super_admin` can't be given through the API.

### Success

**201** with `data`, the new staff member: `id`, `name`, `phone`, `role` (`super_admin` | `admin` | `ops` | `support`), `status` (`active` | `blocked`), `blocked_reason`, `created_at`.

**Next:** Close the form and reload the list.

### Errors

- **422:** field errors. A phone that already has an account gets `errors.phone` = "This phone number already belongs to an account."
- **401:** not logged in, or the login expired. Clear the stored login and go to Login.
- **403:** not a staff account, blocked, or missing the permission (`message` says which). Hide this action for users without the permission.
- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### Notes

- The phone counts as verified. Share the password with the staff member privately and ask them to change it after the first login.

### What it does

Changes a staff member's role.

### Screen

**Staff** page, when the super admin picks a new role for a row and confirms.

### Who can call it

Staff with `staff.manage` (super admin only).

### Request

- Path `staff`: the staff member `id`.
- `role` (required): `admin`, `ops` or `support`.

### Success

**200** with `data`, the staff member with the new role: `id`, `name`, `phone`, `role` (`super_admin` | `admin` | `ops` | `support`), `status` (`active` | `blocked`), `blocked_reason`, `created_at`.

### Errors

- **404:** no staff member with this id (customer accounts are 404 here too).
- **422:** `errors.role` (unknown or `super_admin`), or `errors.staff`: "You cannot change your own role." or "This is the last active super admin, so it cannot be blocked or demoted."
- **401:** not logged in, or the login expired. Clear the stored login and go to Login.
- **403:** not a staff account, blocked, or missing the permission (`message` says which). Hide this action for users without the permission.
- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### Notes

- Hide the change-role action on the logged-in user's own row. The new permissions apply from their next request.

### What it does

Blocks a staff member with a reason. Their logins stop working at once.

### Screen

**Staff** page, when the super admin confirms the **Block** dialog with a reason.

### Who can call it

Staff with `staff.manage` (super admin only).

### Request

- Path `staff`: the staff member `id`.
- `reason` (string, required): up to 255 characters.

### Success

**200** with `data`, the staff member (`status` = `blocked`, `blocked_reason`): `id`, `name`, `phone`, `role` (`super_admin` | `admin` | `ops` | `support`), `status` (`active` | `blocked`), `blocked_reason`, `created_at`.

### Errors

- **404:** no staff member with this id (customer accounts are 404 here too).
- **422:** `errors.reason` (missing or too long), or `errors.staff`: "You cannot block your own account." or "This is the last active super admin, so it cannot be blocked or demoted."
- **401:** not logged in, or the login expired. Clear the stored login and go to Login.
- **403:** not a staff account, blocked, or missing the permission (`message` says which). Hide this action for users without the permission.
- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### Notes

- Hide the block action on the logged-in user's own row. Blocking a blocked staff member answers 200 and only replaces the reason.

### What it does

Unblocks a staff member and clears the reason.

### Screen

**Staff** page, when the super admin clicks **Unblock** on a blocked row (confirm first).

### Who can call it

Staff with `staff.manage` (super admin only).

### Request

- Path `staff`: the staff member `id`. No body.

### Success

**200** with `data`, the staff member (`status` = `active`): `id`, `name`, `phone`, `role` (`super_admin` | `admin` | `ops` | `support`), `status` (`active` | `blocked`), `blocked_reason`, `created_at`.

### Errors

- **404:** no staff member with this id (customer accounts are 404 here too).
- **401:** not logged in, or the login expired. Clear the stored login and go to Login.
- **403:** not a staff account, blocked, or missing the permission (`message` says which). Hide this action for users without the permission.
- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### Notes

- Unblocking an active staff member also answers 200.

item.name: 7. Tayar applications review
item.description:
People who applied to deliver orders. Needs `tayars.view` to see, `tayars.review` to decide:

1. **Tayar applications** page with tabs **Pending**, **Approved**, **Rejected**, a vehicle type filter and a search box (name or phone) → **List tayar applications**, paged, oldest first.
2. Clicking a row opens the **Review details** page → **Get tayar application**: the national ID number, the personal documents (national ID, criminal record, personal photo, driving licence), the vehicle with its licence and photos, the applicant, and the history of earlier reviews.
3. **Approve** → **Approve tayar application**. The vehicle is approved with it.
4. **Reject** opens a dialog with a required reason → **Reject tayar application**. The applicant can fix the application 24 hours later.
5. After either, go back to the list; the application leaves the Pending tab.

request.description:
### What it does

Lists tayar applications for review, filtered by status, oldest first.

### Screen

**Tayar applications** page, on open, on tab change (`status`), on filter or search change and on page change.

### Who can call it

Staff with `tayars.view` (support, ops, admin, super admin).

### Request

- Query `status` (optional): `pending` (default), `approved` or `rejected`.

### What it does

Returns the logged-in user with everything the account screens need.

Any logged-in user who is not blocked (customer, business or staff).

### Request

### Success

**200** with `data`, the user: `id`, `name`, `phone`, `email`, `account_type` (`individual` | `business`), `register_as` (`business` | `tayar`, or null for accounts from before sign up asked for it), `next_step` (the screen to open: see **Get my account**), `locale` (`ar` | `en`), `status` (`active` | `blocked`), `is_phone_verified`, `phone_verified_at`, `national_id` (`status`: null | `pending` | `approved` | `rejected`, `rejection_reason`, `verified_at`, `front` and `back` files with a signed `url`), `business_profile` (or null), `last_mode` (`client` | `tayar`: the mode the app reopens in), `tayar_profile` (`id`, `status`, `is_online`, `rejection_reason`, `can_reapply_at`, or null when the user never applied), `roles` (staff role names, for display only; an empty list for customers) and `permissions` (what the user may do; an empty list for customers, every permission for a super admin).

`next_step` says which screen to open, also after a reinstall or a login on another phone:
- `complete_business_profile`: the business profile form → **Create business profile**.
- `business_under_review`: the "waiting for review" screen (**Get business profile**).
- `business_rejected`: show `business_profile.rejection_reason` and let the user fix the data or documents (**Update business profile**, **Upload document**).
- `complete_tayar_application`: the tayar application form → **Get vehicle types**, then **Apply to be a tayar**.

item.name: 15. Orders
item.description:
Following and cancelling orders (staff with `orders.view`; cancelling needs `orders.manage`):

1. **Orders** page: a table with status, sender, tayar, category, mode and date filters, and a search box (order code or phone) → **List orders**.
2. **Order details** page → **Get order**: the fee breakdown (the tayar earning and platform fee are estimates until a tayar accepts), the tayar and vehicle once accepted, and the status history with who made each change (no name = the system).
3. **Offers** tab on the order details page → **List order offers**: which tayars got the order in each round, and who accepted, rejected or let it expire.
4. **Cancel** button (only while `can_cancel` is true: before pickup, also after a tayar accepted) → a dialog with **Get cancel reasons** and a note → **Cancel order**. Cancelling an accepted order notifies the tayar and never records a fee; a sender who cancelled after the free period shows `cancel_fee` and `cancel_fee_owed_to` (recorded only, settled later by the wallet).
5. **Close as not delivered** button (picked up or on the way; `orders.manage`): when the receiver can't be reached → a dialog with **Get not-delivered reasons** and a required note → **Close as not delivered**. The only status staff can force; the sender and the tayar are both notified.
6. **Resend receiver codes** button (picked up or on the way; `orders.manage`), for a receiver who lost the SMS or hit the lock-out (`receiver_codes.locked`). Staff never see the codes.
7. The status history shows where the tayar was for each step (`lat`, `lng`), and the pickup photos. Delivery does not check payment yet; receivers get codes only once a real SMS provider is configured.

**200** with `data`, the order (`status` = `cancelled`, `cancelled_by_type` = `staff`): `id`, `code`, `status`, `can_cancel`, `sender` (`id`, `name`, `phone`, `business_name`), `category` (`id`, `name` with `ar` and `en`, `is_food`), `mode` (`id`, `code`, `name` with `ar` and `en`: the mode the order was priced in), `details`, `pickup` (`address`, `lat`, `lng`, `contact_phone`), `dropoff` (`address`, `lat`, `lng`), `receiver` (`name`, `phone`, `user_id` when the receiver has an account), `goods_value`, `shipping_paid_by`, `amount_to_collect`, `fee` (`distance_km`, `base_fare`, `price_per_km`, `distance_fare`, `minimum_fare`, `food_extra`, `shipping_fee`, `tayar_share_percent`, `tayar_earning`, `platform_fee`), `tayar` (`id`, `name`, `phone`, or null until a tayar accepts), `vehicle` (the tayar's vehicle for this order: `id`, `type` with `ar` and `en`, `model`, `color`, `plate_number`, or null), `work_session_id` (or null), `cancelled_by_type` (null unless cancelled; then `sender`, `staff` or `system`), `cancel_fee` (owed by the sender for cancelling an accepted order after the free period, `"0.00"` otherwise; recorded only, nothing is charged yet), `cancel_fee_owed_to` (`id`, `name` of the tayar it is owed to, or null), `price_accepted_at`, `accepted_at`, `cancelled_at`, `created_at`, `updated_at`. Amounts are strings with two decimals, in EGP. Delivery: `picked_up_at`, `receiver_confirmed_at`, `delivered_at`, `not_delivered_at`, `not_delivered_reason` (`id`, `name` with `ar` and `en`, or null), `not_delivered_note`, `tracking_token`, `receiver_codes` (`sent_at`, `expire_at`, `attempts`, `locked`; never the codes), plus `cancelled_by` (`id`, `name`, or null), `cancel_reason` (`id`, `name` with `ar` and `en`, or null) and `status_history` (every status change, oldest first: `from_status` (null for the first row), `to_status`, `changed_by` (`id`, `name`, or null for the system), `note`, `lat`, `lng` (where the tayar was, or null for the sender, staff and the system), `created_at`), and `pickup_photos` (each with a signed `url`). The last `status_history` row names the staff member.

**Next:** Show the returned order: `status` = `cancelled` and the new history row.

### Errors

- **404:** no order with this id.
- **422:** field errors, or `errors.status` = "This order can no longer be cancelled." once the order is picked up or finished.
- **401:** not logged in, or the login expired. Clear the stored login and go to Login.
- **403:** not a staff account, blocked, or missing the permission (`message` says which). Hide this action for users without the permission.
- **500:** show a generic error and a retry button.

### Notes

- Ask for confirmation first, with the reasons from **Get cancel reasons**.
- Staff can cancel an accepted (`pending`) order at any time, never with a cancellation fee (`cancel_fee` stays `"0.00"`). The order keeps its `tayar`, and the tayar gets an `order_cancelled` push with `cancelled_by_type` = `staff`.
- Offers still open are withdrawn.
